headline: Conagra (CAG) Stock May Be Fairly Valued After Its Slide
summary: Conagra Brands stock has had a tough few years with the share price down 43.8% over three years, yet the current valuation checks suggest the stock may now be closer to fair value rather than clearly mispriced. The roughly 43.8% share price decline over three years points to weak recent shareholder returns and a market that has marked Conagra down compared with its past position.
